{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Yangyang: Xuanling |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = ...I thought that when I saw you again, words would come pouring out—so many that I wouldn't know where to start. But... now that you're really here, my heart is so full of joy that it pushed everything else away. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = A lot has happened in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}} while you were away. I've written to you about the long and short of it. Yet, some stories are just better told face to face, right? So, the adventures you mentioned in your letters—the {{Extra Effect|Black Shores|The Black Shores|Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.}}, {{Extra Effect|Ragunna|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}}, Septimont, and {{Extra Effect|Lahai-Roi|Lahai-Roi|A civilization located at the polar region of Solaris. Ancient shifts in the planetary axis redefined the world's geography, turning the Lahai-Roi region into what is now the planet's pole. Over time, the vast caverns deep beneath thick layers of ice and snow gradually became habitable for humankind. In this warm and humid underground haven stands an academic metropolis for Resonators, celebrated as the "Research Haven of Solaris" and a "Utopia for Researchers."}}—would you share them with me again? |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = The role of a Xuan Watcher... Though it's only a temporary undertaking, I'm still orienting myself. Sometimes I catch myself worrying about Jinzhou. But Chixia, Baizhi, {{Extra Effect|Magistrate Jinhsi|Magistrate of Jinzhou|The head governor of Jinzhou.
In Huanglong, when a Magistrate takes office, they adopt the region's name as their own. For example, Jinhsi was originally named Hsi but changed her name to Jinhsi after becoming the Magistrate of Jinzhou.}}, and General Jiyan... these names bring peace just at their mentioning. I hope that one day, my name can bring that same reassurance to others. |vo_01_03_mention = Chixia, Baizhi, Jinhsi, Jiyan |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = The night before I left for Xuanfang Hold, I had a nightmare... In it, I was searching for a person... someone I'd never actually met. It wasn't until I woke up that I realized that person was ''you''. But like what you said in your letter—a dream is only a dream. Now that I can see you, touch you, and feel you... I don't think I'll ever have a dream like that again. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I know that after this reunion, the time will come for us to part again. But this time, our shared memories are the stories we lived, we didn't have to reduce them to words in letters. And, through the bittersweetness of our parting, our next meeting may be all the more worth looking forward to... Who knows? Maybe next time, I'll be the one coming to see you. |vo_02_01_title = Yangyang's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = My sister used to take me kite-flying all the time. She'd joke that as long as I was there, we could catch a breeze even on a windless day. But when we were competing to see whose kite flew higher, she'd watch me like a hawk to make sure I didn't cheat—not that she'd stand a chance catching me if I did. |vo_02_02_title = Yangyang's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = I've crossed paths with all kinds of people on this journey. Some walked with me, some passed me by, and some... drew the line against me. With them, there was no middle ground nor room for compromises, no matter how much of ourselves we shared. I know there will be more of this kind the further down this path. But it won't stop me from moving forward. My ideals and faith have forged the blade I carry. It protects at the same time as it cuts... Should the day come when I must point it at others... my resolve was made long ago. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = My mother's cooking... My sister and I both love it. Though neither of us can say we love it as much as Father does. After all, it was her cooking that captured my father's... Ahem—if you're curious about its taste, {{Rover}}, I could try my hand at it. I haven't quite mastered her touch yet, but... I'd probably improve faster with a good taste tester. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Food I dislike? Hm... I'm not a picky eater. But when it comes down to it... eating alone makes the heartiest meal taste bland. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = Protection takes many forms. It can be stepping up for the defenseless, lifting someone out of hardship, or simply offering a quiet ear for someone who's hurting. But whatever the case may be, you must be strong enough to support others. That is why I must press on along my path. I don't dream of gaining the power to protect the world, but for now... I want to stand by your side. Together, I believe we can protect so much more. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = The sword once enshrined in Xianling Village... I didn't realize until the very end that it carried a faint trace of a Xuanling Bird's frequency. Their last songs were echoes of agony and grief. But I can sense the undercurrent of love and longing layered within. It's a melody intricately woven with many sounds, a tribute to life. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = I had never been to {{Extra Effect|Xuanfang|Land of Xuanfang|A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.}} before, and yet... the Streams here feel strangely familiar. After learning the legend of the Xuanling Birds, I've started to sense their presence in the Streams... If only they still existed in the world—no, call it a hunch, but I know they shall re-emerge, and one day, the people of Xuanfang will see them soaring through the skies once more. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Suisui]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Suisui.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = My sister... she's always been a pillar of confidence and reliability. I grew up following in her footsteps, convinced there was nothing in this world she couldn't handle. She's not perfect—she can be stubborn and has a bad temper. Sometimes, I catch a glimpse of her vulnerable side when she tries to compose herself and she thinks I won't notice. To the world, she wears many masks: the noble lady of a great house, a cunning rival, the resourceful president of the commerce guild. But to me, she is simply my sister. |vo_04_01_mention = Suisui |vo_04_02_title = About [[Jinhsi]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Jinhsi.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = {{Extra Effect|Magistrate Jinhsi}}... she carries herself with such poise that it masks her age. I wonder if she feels she doesn't measure up to more experienced leaders, or to the person she envisions herself becoming. What she doesn't see is that, to me and to every citizen of Jinzhou she's ever helped, she's already the best Magistrate we could have asked for. |vo_04_02_mention = Jinhsi |vo_04_03_title = About [[Cartethyia]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Cartethyia.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = The Blessed Maiden of Rinascita, a wandering knight... I can picture her drifting across the land of Rinascita like untethered winds from here on. You see a resemblance between us? Well, our Tacet Marks are both on our foreheads. Though that's probably just a coincidence. We can both transform, too—uh, not in the same way... But when it comes to it, if I could transform into a more "mature" version of myself—Hmm, I don't think I can quite picture that. |vo_04_03_mention = Cartethyia |vo_04_04_title = About [[Liangyu]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Liangyu.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = In {{Extra Effect|Xuanfang}}, Liangyu has been such a huge help to me. Since I'm serving as an acting Xuan Watcher, that technically makes her my superior. She often wears a frown, but once you get to know her, you'll see how deeply she cares for the people she holds dear. Like soft spring rain that quietly nourishes the land, she gives so much of herself in secret—and she gets so shy whenever anyone finds out. |vo_04_04_mention = Liangyu |vo_04_05_title = About Mother |vo_04_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Mother.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = My mother... She was once a renowned composer in {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}}. Father told me she won a music competition when she was even younger than I am now. These days, she's stepped away from the spotlight to focus on our family. Some people say her talent has faded, but that, of course, is only a rumor. My sister and I grew up surrounded by her compositions. They far outnumber even Father's vast collection of books. |vo_04_06_title = About Father |vo_04_06_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_06_file = {character}{language} About Father.ogg |vo_04_06_tx = When I was little, Father always told my sister and me that he was just an ordinary teacher, desiring nothing but an early retirement. It wasn't until much later that I realized what kind of "important figures" his students were... The day I left for {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, he gave me a pen. He said that whether I was happy or sad, it was better to write things down than to keep them bottled up inside. He was worried that I wouldn't find someone to confide in while I was away, but fortunately, I found you. |vo_04_07_title = About the Streams |vo_04_07_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_07_file = {character}{language} About the Streams.ogg |vo_04_07_tx = The Streams... For the longest time, they weren't actual voices. But at some point, something changed. A faint, flickering echo emerged, like a distant, dreamlike call. Since then, I've begun to hear so much more, from both the past and the present. I don't know yet what this shift means, but I've braced myself for whatever it may bring. The wind has taught and guided me. Perhaps, it's up to me to search for the final answer. And I believe it lies within the wind. |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... As always, this song is specially for you. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Fly... Fly high... |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Mm... Hehe... |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = ...Phew, a long journey starts with a single step. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Former {{Extra Effect|Outrider|Outrider|The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations), all under the command of General Jiyan.}} of the {{Extra Effect|Midnight Rangers|Midnight Rangers|The Midnight Rangers are a military force under the Jinzhou Ministry of War, commanded by General Jiyan. They consist of three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations).}}, now the acting Xuan Watcher of Xuanfang Hold—Yangyang. Oh, was that a bit too formal? Mm... a lot has changed, so I figured a proper reintroduction was expected. But between the two of us, no more needs to be said, right? Anyway, let's keep looking out for each other out there. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = ...Long time no see, {{Rover}}. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Follow the wind's lead. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = I'm right here with you. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Don't worry. Leave it to me. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = I'll learn to master this power as quickly as I can...! |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Sounds could be weighty. Jadeite could be made light. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = In the surging currents of the Streams, I hear the constant whispering of the name—"Votary of the Voice." Does it refer to me? Or...? |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = These wings will soar across the skies and the wilds, reach shores no one has set foot on before... and build a bridge that channels all voices of the world. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = I entrust this feather to you. It's more than a charm—it's my vow. Even if your journey takes you somewhere winds don't blow; even if the Streams no longer carry your voice... As long as you carry it and call my name, I will find my way back to you. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Yangyang: Xuanling |language = en |basic_1_tx = Not a chance! |basic_2_tx = Winds, on me! |basic_3_tx = Tempest! |basic_4_tx = Gone with the wind! |heavy_1_tx = Sever the discord! |heavy_2_tx = Set the tone! |heavy_3_tx = Drain the foul! |aerial_1_tx = Fall! |aerial_2_tx = To the ground! |aerial_3_tx = Let the winds roar! |aerial_4_tx = Sounds flow! |aerial_5_tx = All shapes dissipate! |resskill_1_tx = Blade of righteousness... |resskill_2_tx = Stance shift! |resskill_3_tx = Feathers to blades! |resskill_4_tx = Strike the wicked! |resskill_5_tx = Winds return! |resskill_6_tx = Swift as wings! |resliberation_1_tx = All sounds... ceased! |resliberation_2_tx = All world, fall to silence! |resliberation_3_tx = Wings unbound, silence resounds! |introoutro_1_tx = Ceaseless sounds! |introoutro_2_tx = My blade sings! |introoutro_3_tx = Voice unleashed! |introoutro_4_tx = I've got this, Sister! |introoutro_5_tx = Rain ceases, wind rises! |dodge_1_tx = Saw that coming! |counter_1_tx = Reverse! |counter_2_tx = Deflect! |dodgecounter_1_tx = Weakness exposed! |injured_1_tx = ...Getting rough. |injured_2_tx = ...Stay focused! |injured_3_tx = I must... protect everyone... |fallen_1_tx = Deafening... silence... |fallen_2_tx = Sorry...
